On April 21, Trump wrote on Truth Social that he had accepted a request from the Pakistani government to postpone military strikes on Iran and extend the ceasefire. He demanded that Iran first present a unified negotiating proposal. Trump also stressed that the US military would continue the naval blockade and maintain military readiness during the ceasefire. He said the ceasefire would remain in place until a proposal is submitted and negotiations are completed, adding that it could continue “regardless of the outcome.” Markets are watching the extension as a near-term factor that could ease tensions, while the continued blockade may keep uncertainty over energy supplies in focus.
